name: Finspan
description: Wingspan under the sea for 1–5: dive through sunlit, twilight and midnight zones to find fish, lay eggs and grow schools.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** by Stonemaier Games (FS_Rulebook r19), linked from their [Finspan page](https://stonemaiergames.com/games/finspan/).
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Icons are described in words, so check the page image for those. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
Stonemaier also has a [rules and FAQ page](https://stonemaiergames.com/games/finspan/rules-faq/) with a how-to-play video, and a separate **Nautoma** rulebook for solo play.
